newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Nov industrial output up 9.4 pct - gov't.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Nov industrial output up 9.4 pct - gov't.

text.p: Argentina's industrial production in November was 9.4 percent higher than in November 1995, the Economy Ministry said Monday.
In the January-November period output was up by 4.3 percent.
Output in November fell by 5.1 percent compared to October, but seasonally-adjusted output was up 0.7 percent during the month.
November's figures compared with growth in industrial output of 12.5 percent in October from the same month last year. Output in the first 10 months of the year was up 3.8 percent from Jan-Oct 1995.
